positioning: cross-family and workflow-composition generalisation: whole workflow families are held out, but sub-workflows (e.g. authorise a change, move a problem to root cause, map them) recur across splits in new combinations; a write-tool Jaccard below the family threshold is not by itself evidence of no near-duplicate (see family_audit.json cross_split_shared_subworkflows)
usage: train: training-source union (SFT and GRPO candidates); a task's SFT/GRPO use comes only from the usage registry configs/data/itsm_usage_v1.json, never from this split (SFT-only and R1-pending tasks are in train but not GRPO-trainable); dev: debugging and budget/length checks only, not checkpoint selection; heldout: final frozen evaluation only, never for debugging, tuning, length/budget work, Teacher demonstrations or checkpoint selection

method.base: split v2 kept: its 56 tasks keep their v2 split; dev is identical to v2; v3 adds four 6D-2 train tasks and the SFT-only source 78a5b71e_a4fb07a9 to train, and the 6D-3 task 99ba2325_54f35603 to heldout; the assignment is not re-optimised
method.family_rule: as v1/v2: link two tasks if the Jaccard similarity of their gold write-tool sets >= 0.6 or they share a creation tool; families are the connected components over all 62 tasks; a v2 family name is kept only for a family whose members are exactly its v2 members
method.checksums: content_sha256: canonical JSON of the fields that define the task for env and scoring (as v2); source_sha256: canonical JSON of the task's full entry in its source file (provenance, upstream verifiers and validation cases included)

isolation.rule: pairs involving a derived task: <= 1 shared write tool and < 2 shared same-seed gold entities with any dev/held-out task; no near duplicate (same seed, same write-tool set, >= 2 shared gold entities) between any training and evaluation task; no upstream task on both sides. Bench2 train x eval pairs sharing >= 2 write tools are the sub-workflow recombination accepted since v1 and are counted, not blocked
